basis: The dashboard shows Product E's bar top slightly above the 10,000-unit tick, placing its sales volume in the range of approximately 10,000 to 11,500 units. This value falls within the policy range of '>= 8,000 and < 12,500 units'. According to the 'Merchandising policy levels' table, this range maps to the 'Low-sales review queue activation level'. While the value is also within 2,000 units of the 12,500 threshold, the explicit range-based rule for low sales takes precedence over the general variance band in this context.
option_label: Route Product E to low-sales review queue
